attributes.name: Kiranda
attributes.powers:
Kiranda is immune to the Fire, Electricity, and Poison traits. Before you act, succeed at an Arcane or Divine 12 check or you may not play spells that have the Attack trait.

If undefeated, Kiranda deals no damage; instead, bury all armors in your hand, or if you have no armors, bury your hand.
